caption: A tall cardboard box is pulled sideways at its lower corner, tips over, and remains lying on one side.

clauses.text: A hand must grip the lower corner of the cardboard box.
The box must be pulled sideways with sufficient force to initiate tipping.
The box must tip over and come to rest on one of its sides.
The motion must be continuous from the initial pull until the box is fully tipped and stationary.
